categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu JieJie Microelectronics Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, design, production, and sales of power semiconductor chips and devices. Its main product lines include thyristors (SCR), protective devices (TVS, ESD, integrated protective devices), diodes (rectifier, fast recovery, Schottky), thick film modules, transistors, MOSFETs, IGBTs, and silicon carbide (SiC) devices. The company operates primarily under an IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) model with some fabless and outsourced wafer fabrication for certain products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies including silicon wafer processing, ion implantation, oxidation, diffusion, photolithography, and packaging techniques. It integrates chip design, wafer fabrication, device packaging, and testing within its IDM model. Key proprietary technologies include trench MOSFET, SGT MOS, superjunction MOS, and advanced packaging methods such as double-sided cooling and 3D chip stacking. The company also focuses on automotive-grade (AEC-Q101 certified) power semiconductor devices and third-generation semiconductors like SiC and GaN.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JieJie Microelectronics serves a broad range of industries including automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial control, communication equipment, smart home, security, photovoltaic, energy storage, and IoT. Its products are used in applications such as power conversion, motor drives, lighting control, surge protection, and renewable energy systems. The company’s customer base includes large domestic and international brands, with growing penetration in high-end automotive and 5G communication markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, with over 90% of revenue generated domestically. It also exports products to technologically advanced regions including South Korea, Japan, Spain, and Taiwan. The company has subsidiaries and R&D centers in multiple Chinese cities such as Shanghai, Shenzhen, Nanjing, Wuxi, Nantong, and Chengdu, and is expanding its global footprint with market and talent presence in Singapore and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: JieJie Microelectronics operates mainly as an IDM, covering the full supply chain from chip design, wafer fabrication, device packaging, testing, to sales and service. It controls upstream wafer processing and midstream device manufacturing, with some wafer fabrication outsourced to foundries. The company also engages in downstream activities including customized product design and direct sales to end customers, positioning itself as a vertically integrated power semiconductor manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in automotive-grade power semiconductors, including MOSFETs, IGBTs, and SiC devices, aiming for domestic substitution of imports and international competitiveness. It invests heavily in advanced chip structures like trench and SGT MOSFETs, ultra-fast recovery diodes, and high-reliability packaging technologies. Collaboration with research institutes and universities supports innovation. The company also focuses on expanding product applications in new energy vehicles, 5G, AI, IoT, and renewable energy sectors, while enhancing manufacturing automation and smart factory capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor chips, discrete devices, and power modules. The company sells both standard products and customized solutions tailored to specific customer requirements. Sales are conducted mainly through direct sales channels, with a focus on building strategic partnerships with large brand customers and quality distributors. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income, but product sales constitute the core revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international large semiconductor manufacturers who dominate the high-end power semiconductor market. Domestically, it is among the leading IDM power semiconductor manufacturers with a growing market share, especially in thyristors, diodes, and protective devices. JieJie is recognized for its chip design and manufacturing capabilities, enabling it to compete effectively in import substitution and expanding into automotive and industrial applications. Its competitive advantages include integrated IDM operations, advanced technology, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 2.84 billion, representing a 35% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 473 million, more than doubling year-over-year. Total assets stood at about RMB 8.05 billion, with net assets of RMB 5.81 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations, though investment cash outflows increased due to ongoing capacity expansion projects. R&D expenses accounted for about 9.56% of revenue, underscoring its commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JieJie Microelectronics emphasizes its integrated IDM model, enabling full control over chip design, manufacturing, and packaging, which ensures high product quality, reliability, and customization capabilities. Its proprietary technologies such as trench and SGT MOSFETs, advanced packaging, and automotive-grade certifications differentiate its products in performance and application scope. The company’s ability to rapidly develop and produce customized power semiconductor solutions tailored to diverse customer needs provides a competitive edge. Additionally, its focus on import substitution and expanding into emerging markets like automotive electronics and renewable energy enhances its value proposition.
